description: Search the 2026 rating list for England and Wales. Give a full postcode (e.g. 'WR3 8TJ') or an outward code (e.g. 'WR3'), optionally narrowed by words from the address or the description (e.g. 'unit 96a', 'cafe'), or a council's ba_code. Returns up to 20 properties with property_id, address, description, rateable value and business name where known. One building can hold many separate entries (floors, suites): ask which one if that matters. Use the property_id with the other tools. Costs 1 credit.

ba_code.description: Council (billing authority) code, e.g. '1835' for Worcester. Use instead of postcode.

include.description: Optional extra sections for the answer. The ones available are listed in the response under settings.include_supported; anything else is ignored and listed in settings.ignored. Leave out unless the user asks for something the normal answer lacks.

options.description: Optional extra settings by name. The ones available are listed in the response under settings.options_supported; anything else is ignored and listed in settings.ignored.

postcode.description: Full postcode or outward code, e.g. 'BD13 3EL' or 'BD13'.

query.description: Words from the address or the VO description to narrow the results, e.g. 'unit 2' or 'cafe'.

uarn.description: A UARN, instead of postcode or ba_code: returns every current entry it covers, England and Wales.

name: find_properties
title: Find business properties
